text:
jon_sales: Quick sync - client wants a short POC to validate BYO-HSM + Redwood proxy fallback. Main asks: rotation dry-run, attestation artifacts, and whether POC ops can be credited toward Dedicated commit.
eli_se: Ill take the runbook. Two modes: proxy-only and hybrid with KEK cache. Target for POC: 8k ops/min, median lookup <60ms.
client_ops: Well bring our HSM for POC; need a proxy fallback if latency spikes. Also need logs for every rotation event.
sam_eng: Config notes: `cache_ttl_ms` default 60000, `grace_period_ms` default 120000. We can set `fallback_window_ms=180000` for the dry-run.
jon_sales: Billing question: will rotation dry-run produce metered charges? Client worried about surprises.
billing_bot: Proxy HSM egress is metered per-op. Sales can request a trial-credit token to zero-rate ops up to a cap for the POC. Submit request to Sales Ops with trial_id.
carol_legal: SOW must include attestation retention (90 days), JSONL rotation logs, and carve-outs for upstream HSM provider outages.
eli_se: Example admin API import (curl): ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/v1/keys/import -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -F 'key=@cmk.pem'```
client_ops: We need attestation sample to present to auditors.
sam_eng: Will provide JSONL attestation example + small `rotation-check` script. Sample line: {"ts":"2026-06-10T11:00:00Z","evt":"rotation_started","cmk":"cmk-fn-01"}
eli_se: Actions: @sam_eng deliver bench + attestation sample; @jon_sales open trial-credit; @client_ops share egress CIDRs by EOD.
jon_sales: Thanks, filing trial request now. Reopen if blockers.
